name: feature
input: A requested user-visible or system capability.

steps.name: locate
steps.action: Map the request to Nx projects and owners.
steps.proof: Affected projects and agents are named.

steps.name: define
steps.action: State the smallest outcome, acceptance evidence, and stop conditions.
steps.proof: The slice can be observed failing before implementation.

steps.name: build
steps.action: Implement independent slices in isolated worktrees.
steps.proof: Each owner passes the narrowest Nx check.

steps.name: integrate
steps.action: Combine the slices and remove superseded work.
steps.proof: Affected Nx checks and review pass together.

proof: The requested capability works and its affected checks pass.
